description_en: Creates a note for a security alert event
description_zh: 创建告警事件的备注信息
name: CreateSuspEventNote

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security alert event to which you want to add a note. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/251497.html to obtain the ID of the alert event
parameters.help_zh: 要添加备注的告警事件的ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/251497.html获取告警事件的ID
parameters.name: event_id

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The detailed information about the error code
Message.example: There was an error with your request.

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
The result of processing the alert event. Valid values:

true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
异常事件处理的结果状态。取值：

true：处理成功。
false：处理失败
